categories.main_business_segments: Guangdong Wanlima Industry Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the leather, fur, feather products, and footwear industry. Its main business includes R&D, design, manufacturing, brand operation, and sales of leather goods and individual protective products. The company also operates e-commerce platforms through subsidiaries, providing comprehensive services for mother and baby products, outdoor sports products, and cosmetics. Its product portfolio includes handbags, wallets, luggage, shoes, belts, and fashion accessories under self-owned brands Wanlima, Saint Jack, and COOME, as well as ODM manufacturing for international brands.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs a combination of in-house production and outsourced manufacturing, using advanced production technologies and strict quality control systems certified by ISO9001 and ISO14001 standards. It integrates modern high-tech applications such as ultrasonic, electronic, microwave, and high-pressure technologies in product development, especially for functional leather products. The production process emphasizes environmental protection with clean production techniques and the use of eco-friendly materials. R&D focuses on product innovation, quality improvement, and functional development, supported by a professional design team and collaboration with external design agencies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Wanlima serves a diverse customer base including military, police, government agencies, state-owned enterprises, and middle-class consumers. The core marketing channel is group purchasing, accounting for over 60% of revenue, primarily serving military and police systems. The company also targets retail consumers through direct sales, e-commerce, and distribution channels. Its products cater to both civilian and military/police markets, with a growing focus on protective equipment for firefighting and emergency rescue sectors. The company also actively expands into international defense markets through participation in global defense exhibitions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with significant sales in North China, South China, East China, and expanding overseas markets including Europe and the Middle East. Its retail and distribution networks cover first- and second-tier cities, with a presence in third- and fourth-tier cities through agents. Subsidiaries operate e-commerce platforms targeting nationwide consumers. The company also has subsidiaries and investments in Hong Kong and Zhejiang province, supporting cross-border e-commerce and brand operations.
categories.supply_chain_position: Wanlima operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. It engages in product design, manufacturing (both in-house and outsourced), brand management, and multi-channel sales including group purchasing, retail, e-commerce, and ODM production for international brands. The company manages procurement of raw materials such as leather and hardware from qualified suppliers and controls quality throughout the production process. It also provides e-commerce platform operations and logistics services through subsidiaries, integrating upstream supply with downstream sales channels.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on multi-brand, multi-channel, and multi-category development, emphasizing high-quality, high-value, and cost-effective products. It prioritizes R&D in individual soldier and police protective equipment, firefighting gear, and special combat apparel aligned with national military-civil integration policies. Wanlima is advancing digital transformation, intelligent manufacturing, and AI-enabled e-commerce operations, particularly in live streaming and brand management. The company aims to enhance brand value, expand domestic and international markets, and pursue mergers and acquisitions to strengthen core competitiveness and scale.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales across multiple channels: group purchasing (primarily military and government contracts), direct retail stores, e-commerce platforms, wholesale distribution, and ODM manufacturing for international brands. The company also earns service fees from e-commerce platform operations and brand agency services. Group purchasing accounts for the majority of revenue, followed by online sales and distribution. The company does not rely on subscription or licensing models but focuses on physical product sales and related service income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Wanlima is positioned as a leading domestic mid-to-high-end leather goods and protective equipment brand in China, competing with other Chinese brands like Goldlion, Belle International, Aokang, and Red Dragonfly. It faces competition from international luxury and high-end brands in the upper market segments but holds a strong position in the mid-range market with a focus on military and government procurement. The company leverages its brand heritage, quality, and government relationships to maintain competitive advantages in a highly fragmented and competitive domestic market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Wanlima reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 586.6 million, a 5.07% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 175.9 million, reflecting intensified industry competition and operational challenges. The company’s total assets stood at around RMB 754.1 million, with equity attributable to shareholders at RMB 313.9 million, showing a decline compared to prior years. Despite recent losses, the company maintains stable cash flow from operations and continues investing in R&D and channel expansion, aiming for sustainable growth through strategic adjustments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Wanlima emphasizes its strong brand heritage as a well-recognized Chinese leather goods brand with over 20 years of history, combining quality craftsmanship with fashion-forward design. Its unique value lies in customized products for military and police clients with stringent quality and functional requirements, alongside diversified consumer product lines catering to mid-to-high-end market segments. The company differentiates through integrated multi-channel sales, including stable group purchasing contracts, innovative e-commerce operations, and continuous product innovation focused on protective and functional apparel. Its commitment to quality control, environmental sustainability, and brand building underpins its competitive positioning.
